title: Refinery process pump, cut open
label: API 610 pump skid cut open: a tall suction drum with amber liquid, flanged elbow, basket strainer, gate valve and arched suction loop into a half-sectioned volute, shaft, finned motor, discharge riser and trend panel.
caption: Gas oil at 255 °C falls from the drum through the strainer into the impeller eye. Drag left to throttle the valve, right to drop the drum level and then clog the strainer: once the suction margin goes negative, vapour sheets grow on the vanes and the head on the curve drops.
